verdicts.reason: A keeps the original hierarchy and reading order (logo, kicker, headline, details, prominent RSVP button) and adapts the layout to the square, but it is still mostly a widened copy: the bottom third is dead space, the legal text is tiny, and the placeholder partner box floats on its own. B breaks the design. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a small pill grouped with the badges, 'Solstice Presents' has dropped below the details, the date, tagline, URL and time are jammed together on ragged, misaligned left edges, and the phone dominates in place of the headline.

A is the same broken layout: the CTA is demoted to a badge pill, the reading order is scrambled ('Solstice Presents' sits under the details), and the info block is cramped and misaligned with no clear hierarchy. B keeps the original structure and a strong RSVP button, but the badge pills are spread out unevenly and the 'Free Entry' pill sticks out past the date's left edge. The phone is also pushed against the right edge, the legal text starts at yet another x position, and the bottom is largely empty.
